description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the DumpMetaList operation, which queries the list of metadata export tasks in an Image Search instance
description_zh: 本文为您介绍DumpMetaList接口的语法及示例，用于向图像搜索实例中查看元信息导出任务列表
name: DumpMetaList

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is not the instance ID. The instance name must be unique within the same region. Make sure you distinguish between the two
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，且实例名称同区域内唯一不可重复，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the metadata export task.
To obtain the export task ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/377466.html operation first and retrieve the ID from the response
parameters.help_zh:
元信息导出任务ID。
导出任务ID，需要先执行https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/377466.html从返回值得到
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。默认值为10，最大值30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results. Default value: 1. Maximum value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。默认值为1，最大值30
parameters.name: page_number

DumpMetaList.description_en: The collection of metadata export tasks

items.description_en: The details of a metadata export task

Code.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

0: Succeeded.
Non-zero: Failed
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

0：成功。
非0：失败

MetaUrl.description_en: The URL for downloading the result. The URL is valid for two hours
MetaUrl.description_zh: 结果下载地址。有效期两个小时

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
PROCESSING: The task is being processed.
FAIL: The task failed.
SUCCESS: The task is completed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
PROCESSING：任务处理中。
FAIL：任务执行失败。
SUCCESS：任务已完成

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created. Unit: milliseconds
UtcCreate.description_zh: 任务创建时间。单位毫秒

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the task was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
UtcModified.description_zh: 任务更新时间。单位毫秒
